description: This file is a shell script that contains automated tests for verifying the behavior of 'git rebase --signoff' and related options. It sets up git repositories, runs various rebase commands with '--signoff' and other flags, and checks that commit messages are correctly signed off, or not signed off, according to expectations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, with a descriptive message and a series of commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified files.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Verifies the commit message of the current HEAD matches the expected message.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a specified path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after tests are completed, for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs to verify they are identical.
